projectDescription: Labrador is a guided manual accessibility testing platform that helps consultants and teams conduct structured WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 audits, document issues, collaborate, and export professional client-ready reports.
keyFeatures: Guided WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 criterion-by-criterion testing with built-in testing tips
Page and component-level audit management within projects
Issue documentation with severity levels, remediation status, and media uploads
Audit versioning and retest workflows (v1.0 → v1.1 etc.)
AI-assisted remediation suggestions powered by Claude Opus 5 via Chrome extension
Jira Cloud integration with two-way status/priority sync
Professional exports: interactive HTML, DOCX/VPAT, CSV, and Jira-ready CSV
Team collaboration with role-based permissions (view-only, developer, editor)
Criterion-level comments and notifications for team members
Custom fields and reusable custom field templates
publicApiSurface: Projects dashboard — create, manage, and version accessibility audit projects
Pages & Components — add URLs and components to a project for individual testing
Criteria Overview — evaluate and mark WCAG success criteria Pass/Fail/N/A/Untested
Issue Logger — document failures with description, severity, remediation status, and attachments
Audit Versions — create retest versions (minor bump) or new audit versions (major bump)
Export — HTML report, CSV, Jira-ready CSV, VPAT DOCX
Jira Integration — connect project to Jira Cloud, configure mappings and templates
Chrome Extension (Labrador AI Accessibility Assistant) — capture live page HTML for AI remediation
Team Management — invite members, assign roles, manage seats
